title: Concept: Apache Druid console is reachable without authentication
description: Druid is a query engine with an open SQL endpoint behind the same host; a reachable console usually means the broker is reachable too, so the caller can read any datasource and often write to it.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller reads every ingested event and can rewrite retention or ingestion rules for the datasources the cluster holds.
